content.query:
GuardicorePolicyRules_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| where action contains "block"
| extend RulesetName = case(
    isempty(ruleset_name) or ruleset_name == "", "default",
    ruleset_name
)
| summarize TotalHitCount = sum(hit_count) by RulesetName
| top 10 by TotalHitCount desc
| project RulesetName, BlockingHits = TotalHitCount
content.title: Top Blocking Rulesets – lifetime hit count (rules polled: {TimeRange:label})

content.query:
let startDate = startofday({TimeRange:start});
let endDate = startofday({TimeRange:end});
let all_days = range day from startDate to endDate step 1d;
// GuardicoreApplications_CL is filled from Centra GET /api/v3.0/workflow/projects = the Centra "Projects" page.
// Last known state of each project (by id) per day; labels match the Centra Projects grid State column.
let daily_counts = GuardicoreApplications_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= startDate and TimeGenerated < endDate + 1d
| extend day = startofday(TimeGenerated)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, state) by id, day
| summarize
    ['Published Block'] = countif(state == "PUBLISHED_BLOCK"),
    ['Published Alert'] = countif(state == "PUBLISHED_ALERT"),
    Published = countif(state == "PUBLISHED")
    by day;
all_days
| join kind=leftouter (daily_counts) on day
| project day = format_datetime(day, "yyyy-MM-dd"),
          ['Published Block'] = coalesce(['Published Block'], 0),
          ['Published Alert'] = coalesce(['Published Alert'], 0),
          Published = coalesce(Published, 0)
| sort by day asc
content.title: Projects by State ({TimeRange:label})

content.query:
GuardicorePolicyRules_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| summarize count = count() by action
| extend actionFormatted = replace("_", " ", tolower(action))
| extend actionFormatted = strcat(toupper(substring(actionFormatted, 0, 1)), substring(actionFormatted, 1))
| project Action = actionFormatted, Count = count
| order by Count desc
content.title: Policy Rules by Action Type ({TimeRange:label})

content.json: Workload protection status across your environment for the selected time range. An agent is **protected** when its enforcement module is running and its effective operating mode is *Enforcing* (an Unset mode falls back to the agent's default operating mode, as in Centra). **Agent Issues** shows how many agents currently report each Centra agent status flag, by severity.

content.title: Protected vs Not Protected Agents ({TimeRange:label})
content.noDataMessage: No Guardicore agent data in the selected time range

content.query:
// Centra agent status flags (AgentStatusFlagType). Numeric values are mapped to names in case the API returns numbers.
let FlagNames = dynamic({"2":"PollingMode","3":"OutdatedPolicy","4":"OutdatedConfiguration","5":"NoRevealReceived",
    "6":"HighDropRate","7":"AgentMissing","8":"PartialPolicy","9":"EnforcementPaused","10":"NoRevealReported",
    "11":"RevealOffline","12":"EnforcementOffline","13":"RevealModuleError","14":"EnforcementModuleError",
    "15":"DetectionModuleError","16":"DeceptionModuleError","17":"ControllerModuleError","18":"NoResourceLimits",
    "19":"MemoryLimitReached","20":"RevealMemoryLimitReached","21":"EnforcementMemoryLimitReached",
    "22":"DetectionMemoryLimitReached","23":"DeceptionMemoryLimitReached","24":"ControllerMemoryLimitReached",
    "25":"LimitedPolicy","26":"EnforcementModeRevealOnly","27":"EnforcementModeMonitoring"});
// latest state of each agent in the selected time range
GuardicoreAgents_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, status_flags) by id
| mv-expand flag = status_flags
| extend ft = tostring(flag.flag_type), sev = toupper(tostring(flag.severity))
| extend flag_name = iff(isnotempty(FlagNames[ft]), tostring(FlagNames[ft]), ft)
| where isnotempty(flag_name)
// hidden in the Centra UI too: the operating mode is shown by the protection chart
| where flag_name !in ("EnforcementModeMonitoring", "EnforcementModeRevealOnly")
| extend Issue = replace_regex(flag_name, @"([a-z])([A-Z])", @"\1 \2")
| extend Severity = case(sev in ("ERROR", "20"), "Error", sev in ("WARNING", "10"), "Warning", "Information")
| summarize Error = dcountif(id, Severity == "Error"),
            Warning = dcountif(id, Severity == "Warning"),
            Information = dcountif(id, Severity == "Information"),
            Agents = dcount(id)
            by Issue
| top 15 by Agents desc
| project Issue, Error, Warning, Information
content.title: Agent Issues ({TimeRange:label})
content.noDataMessage: No agent issues reported by Centra in the selected time range
